violations.reason: The driver import for the only sqlite3 connection in the engine closure (grep sqlite3 in this file: 3 hits, all at 40/5679/5682; 0 hits in the other 7 closure modules). It exists solely to open the margin-rest reservation ledger at :5682, so it is classified with the store it enables, not as a bare import.

PRAGMA busy_timeout on the reservation-ledger connection opened at :5682: concurrent senders BLOCK on the ledger instead of failing, which is what makes the cross-process reservation atomic. Persists no row by itself, but it is a site on the authoritative ledger.

PRAGMA synchronous=FULL: forces each committed reservation to be written through to disk. This is the durability property of the authoritative store, not a tuning nicety - without it the ledger would not survive the crash it exists to survive.

violations.excerpt: conn.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reservations " |                          "(token TEXT PRIMARY KEY, coin TEXT NOT NULL, notional REAL NOT NULL, " |                          "state TEXT NOT NULL, created_ms INTEGER NOT NULL)")
violations.reason: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reservations (token TEXT PRIMARY KEY, coin, notional, state, created_ms): the schema of the persistent trading-state record - one row per reserved margin claim keyed by sha256(scope,intent_id). This is the store itself.

BEGIN IMMEDIATE takes the write lock BEFORE the collateral read, making check-then-insert atomic across processes. That atomicity is the engine own tested property (test_parallel_processes_cannot_double_spend).

The durable WRITE: INSERT (token, coin, required, UNRESOLVED, utc_now_ms()) before the order reaches the wire. This row is the persistent trading state - it is what constrains every later send, in this process and after restart, until exchange reconciliation.
COMMIT of the reservation. After this the engine treats the margin as spent even if the process dies immediately (made durable by synchronous=FULL at :5684).
ROLLBACK on the duplicate-guard hit path (:5689): releases the write lock without inserting. Persists nothing itself, but it is the abort half of the same authoritative transaction.
ROLLBACK when live withdrawable < reserved + required (:5702): the insufficient-collateral refusal path. Persists nothing; abort half of the same transaction.
